extraction.notes: Reconciliation taken from the FFO, Core FFO and AFFO table (printed page 18), three months ended June 30, 2023. Starting line is net loss of (3,968), which differs from the Financial Summary's net loss attributable to common stockholders of (3,953); the FFO table's figure was used. Gain on extinguishment of debt is printed as an em dash for the quarter and recorded as 0. Gain on forfeited deposits is categorized as 'other'. Recurring capex of 3,540 (quarter) comes from the Historical Capital Expenditures table (printed page 19); AFFO does not subtract it, and the table does not state its scope explicitly. Checks: 19,828/26,304=0.75, 20,370/26,304=0.77, 23,232/26,304=0.88.
